semanticChecks.scope: Owner AI translated the entire week directly from Japanese: seven sections / 37 distinct paragraph records, seven lesson metadata records / 14 objectives / seven art captions, seven questions / 28 options / 28 specific rationales. Full Japanese comparison and continuous Hindi teaching-prose, metadata and question self-review completed. No other target language, pivot or semantic cross-review used.
semanticChecks.reserveReadiness: Bag presence/counts not usability; facility inspection method, compatible batteries/power, actual readiness and known storage location retained. Cash/documents support disaster assistance/information but must follow role management and protect money/private data from unrestricted removal. Individual mobility/hearing-aid/routine-care/current-medication needs checked with person and responsible staff, shared bag not all needs met. Expired/mismatched stock not usable; record reason/shortage/refill owner/next check and separate unconfirmed. Radio incompatible battery distinct from hearing-aid spare supplies unchecked. No universal quantity/type list; actual facility plan/person needs, medicines with responsible staff or medical professionals and no list-based type/amount changes.
semanticChecks.personSideAnatomy: Right/left anchored to service recipient, facing staff sees reversed sides. Own established ascending/transverse/descending colon terms retained; normally right-up, transverse, left-down and lower-right→upper-right→left→lower-left locations preserved. Diagram direction not pressure/time/repetitions/permission for abdominal procedure. Abdominal pain report includes site/onset/person words to explicit medical professionals or guidance responsible staff; no cause inference or force procedure from image. Pregnancy/inflammatory bowel disease/surgery/wounds are important consultation conditions, not independently decisive eligibility; suitable response confirmed with professionals.
semanticChecks.distinctGenitalAnatomy: Scrotum external sac, testes internal glands, foreskin skin over glans at penis tip all distinct. Unclear named part/instruction must be checked, not same motion from similar names. No guessed pulling direction/force; do not begin unconfirmed action, check with guidance responsible staff or medical professionals. Pain/resistance not forced continuation, state reported. Modesty/privacy, no unnecessary public exposure or irrelevant sharing, necessary recipient gets observed part/person words/unknowns separately. Original male wiping motion explicitly not established here as safe technique; individual hygiene procedure follows professional instruction/facility method.
semanticChecks.qolAndParticipation: QOL life quality includes satisfaction/happiness/meaning, staff work quantity not person benefit proof. Ask personal meaning and words, not staff preferences. Motor assistance distinct from self-choice of activity/time/role; help quantity not satisfaction/will. Source paragraph photo count and separate question completed-book count preserved without equating them to satisfaction. Person wants memory-talk time; ask desired participation and review as team, no single-reply diagnosis or lone plan change. Community inclusion requires personal choice, desired role and workable method, not mere same-room presence. Audio-recorded-book experience can be introduced with suitable preparation, not restricted to independently reading printed text or forced identical method. Actual wishes/ability/support/place/operations checked with person and responsible staff; no activity claimed suitable for all.
semanticChecks.servicePlaceAndUsage: Home visit staff goes to person, day service person attends then returns home, residential person lives there while receiving support. Vehicle/staff presence alone insufficient. Actual handover person/date/time/place/help checked; unresolved plans separate, type name not confirmed appointment. Classification is not individual eligibility/insurance-benefit/fee/facility-selection decision. Actual coordination with person wishes, responsible staff and care-support specialist retained.
semanticChecks.implementationVersusAchievement: Care plan connects desired life to concrete goals/support, not only staff actions. Actual work record distinct from response/outcome and goal progress. Three invitations not proof person understood and chose activity; prompt retains every-time response in question but source paragraph single quote kept as authored. Team reviews missing information/explanation/participation conditions/goal fit, no blame on insufficient effort. Record done/response/unknown separately and share with person/responsible staff; goal/help-quantity changes only after consultation.
semanticChecks.readingsCaptionsRegister: All seven source readingJa fields are explicitly empty and every target question has reading:"". No full or absent readings. Actual source has zero figureCaptionsJa keys; all seven complete lesson art captions translated with their image-scope limitations. Respectful adult connected Hindi, no invented gender/age/kinship or medical procedure. Existing own preferred terms and profile retained; no exact prior Japanese paragraph overlap or repeated paragraph in this unit.
